sections.title: What Cook could and could not do

items.q: What was Cook actually good at when Jobs died?
items.a: **Systems, not invention.** IBM just-in-time, Compaq cost-down, Apple inventory **30 days → 2 days**. He had never designed a product. The 15-year record matches that split.

items.q: What is the video's one-line verdict on the Cook era?
items.a: A mortal can wear the crown if the company already leads — **discipline then beats intuition**. Dull keynotes, yearly camera/chip increments, kill the undifferentiated bet, do not ship unfinished Siri.

sections.title: Design trap, then a real moat

items.q: How did Ive's 2000s language become a 2010s trap?
items.a: **Curve, color, extreme thinness** won iMac/iPod/Air, then produced the cylinder Mac Pro, the one-port fanless MacBook, and the butterfly keyboard. Looks first, week-long use second.

items.q: Why is Apple Silicon a different kind of moat than pretty aluminum?
items.a: Merchant parts are **copyable**. A chip the competitor **cannot buy** is not. M1 tiled into Pro/Max/Ultra and let Apple stop treating CNC thinness as the product.

items.q: What does “hardware in, ecosystem out” mean?
items.a: The phone is the door. **iCloud photos, IAP accounts, default Google search (~$20B/year), 15–30% store tax** are the walls. Hardware GM ~37%; services ~74%.

items.q: What failed in the same pattern: car, headset, smart Siri?
items.a: Cook can **max a proven category**. Titan (~2,000 people, ~$1B/year, L5 fantasy → 2024 kill), Vision Pro (best headset, no job-to-be-done), rule-based Siri vs ChatGPT. Demoed Apple Intelligence that was not on the device.

items.q: Why do near-100% buybacks matter in the AI capex race?
items.a: 2024–25 buybacks+dividends **≈ or above net income**. 2026 Apple capex ~$14B vs ~$650B across Meta/Google/Microsoft/Amazon. Either the profit needs no reinvestment — or the skipped AI bet is the future bill.

items.q: Why did the market barely move when Cook named Ternus?
items.a: John Ternus already ran the **M-series transition** — the era's biggest experience upgrade. Announcement-day stock ~**-0.58%**. The method outlived the man.

items.q: Which three stories does 何同学 use to show who Cook is?
items.a: Offered **part of his liver** to Jobs (refused). 2014 **“bloody ROI”** snap on accessibility. 2021 **patience** with a rambling student interviewer — the creator himself.
